defeats.how: Thor knocked the Absorbing Man into the lake, where he absorbed the properties of water and flowed away.
defeats.evidence: Thor manages to defeat him by knocking him into the lake

defeats.how: The synopsis only says Thor defeated the two dogs Loki had transformed to kill him.
Thor defeated Loki, who had summoned the Firesword, with a lightning strike that also blinded him.
defeats.evidence: Thor manages to defeat Loki with a lightning strike
